title: Even-Wear Inspection Points — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Even-wear points are added to the covered-mileage percentage of a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty treadwear adjustment credit, following the set's tread inspection history.

| Inspection history of the set | Points added |
|---|---|
| no tread inspection entry records irregular alignment wear or irregular inflation wear, and the set carries at least two inspection readings per tire (at least two times the set's tire count in inspection entries) | 5 |
| no such irregular entry, and fewer readings than that | 2 |
| any inspection entry records irregular alignment or irregular inflation wear | 0 |

Every tread inspection entry of the set counts as a reading, whatever position it measured. Entries recording even wear or damage are not irregular entries for this purpose.

**Cases (hypothetical 4-tire sets):** 8 inspection entries, all even wear — 5 points; 6 entries, all even — 2 points; 12 entries, one of them irregular inflation wear — 0 points.
